Chat request that includes a developer role message alongside user messages

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { Message, createClient } from "@xberg-io/liter-llm";
async function main() {
  const client = createClient("your-api-key");
  const result = await client.chat({ messages: [{ role: "developer", developer: { content: "You are a coding assistant. Always respond with concise code examples." } } as Message, { role: "user", user: { content: "How do I reverse a string in Python?" } } as Message], model: "gpt-4" });
  console.log(result.choices);
  console.log(result.choices?.[0]?.message?.content);
  console.log(result.choices?.[0]?.finishReason);
}

void main();
```
